hooks.name: Remind to update GUIDELINE.md
hooks.description: When a task completes, remind to document new features/changes in GUIDELINE.md

action.prompt: A task has just been completed. Check if this task involved adding a new feature, plugin, configuration, or any significant change to the Backstage project. If it did, update the GUIDELINE.md file at the project root to document what was done — add it to the relevant section (Cấu hình đã thực hiện, Changelog, or TODO). Keep the documentation concise and in the same style as existing entries.
